text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — after-launch iteration planning for chat-threads. We have 3 customer reports: memory leak (prod OOM), autocomplete regression, and minor UI overflow. Need to decide hotfix vs backlog. @Priya @Marcos thoughts?

Priya Singh: Memory leak looks like P1 from AcmeCorp — repro on long-lived sessions. Recommend hotfix. Autocomplete is P2. UI overflow low impact.

Marcos Rivera: +1 hotfix for memory leak. We should canary it and monitor Sentry + Prometheus. Timeline: aim for patch in ~24h.

Jenna Patel: Heads up — we have an A/B retention test in prod right now. If hotfix touches session handling, prefer targeted canary to affected customers or an opt-in flag to avoid skewing the experiment.

Alex Chen: Agreed. Proposed rollout:
```
canary: 1% for 30m -> 10% for 2h -> 100% if no regressions
targets: org:AcmeCorp, tag:hotfix-eligible
```

Priya Singh: I'll own the bugfix. Test plan: unit tests for session lifecycle, staging stress run (6h), and add SLO alert threshold for mem usage.

Sam O'Neill: Release-eng ack. We can schedule deploy during maintenance window 02:00 UTC. I'll prepare rollback script and measurement dashboard. Canary automation ready.

release-bot: Deploy job created: patch/chat-threads-memoryfix -> queued.

Marcos Rivera: Also add a CI regression that simulates long-running convo + 8k tokens to catch KV/cache leaks. Add metric: per-session heap over time.

Jenna Patel: Outcome/next steps: create two tickets — HOTFIX-5123 (bugfix, priority=high, owner=Priya) and ENH-6129 (autocomplete improvements, owner=product backlog). Include acceptance criteria and rollout plan in HOTFIX-5123.

Alex Chen: Action items
- Priya: PR + tests + staging stress run (due: +18h)
- Sam: Prepare deploy pipeline + rollback (due: +20h)
- Marcos: CI regression and metrics dashboard (due: +24h)
- Jenna: Coordinate with growth to exempt A/B groups or enable opt-in flag (due: +12h)
Please confirm if these look right. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Confirmed. :thumbsup:
